extracted.name: Quick Garlic Breadsticks
extracted.description: Use hot dog buns for garlic bread! No need for fancy bread loaves, just slather a buttery, cheesy, herb mixture onto hot dog buns for instant garlic bread.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Stir Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, and basil together in a small bowl.
Place hot dog buns, cut-sides up, onto the prepared baking sheet. Spread margarine onto buns, then sprinkle Parmesan mixture over top.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 10 minutes.
